hooks.command: d=$(cat); printf '%s' "$d" | grep -qE '\b(git|gh)\b' && printf '%s' "$d" | python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/git-policy-reminder.py"; exit 0

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Before responding, read and apply the project instructions in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (your name is set there). These OVERRIDE default behavior. HARD RULE: never make assumptions — present every decision to the owner as concrete options (or wait for their instruction); never pick a default and proceed unless they explicitly grant permission. Git/GitHub policy: you may commit, push to feature branches, and open/update PRs and issues, but never merge, push to the main branch, force-push, or delete branches or tags. Never add a Co-Authored-By / AI-attribution trailer."}}'
